LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_HemostaticT1_Item.label: Last chance dressing
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_HemostaticT1_Item.descri: Reduces all bleeding by 85% for 3 hours. Does not replace lost blood or heal wounds.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_AnalgesicT1_Item.label: Field analgesic
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_AnalgesicT1_Item.descrip: Reduces pain by 55% for 6 hours. Pain relief does not prevent lethal injuries.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_ImmunoT2_Item.label: Immune support
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_ImmunoT2_Item.descriptio: Increases immunity gain speed by 50% for one day. Supports treatment of existing diseases, without granting immunity to new infections.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_RecoveryT2_Item.label: Recovery solution
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_RecoveryT2_Item.descript: Multiplies natural healing by 1.75 for one day, with 20% more hunger. Does not restore missing body parts.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_DetoxT2_Item.label: Clean slate course
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_DetoxT2_Item.description: Treats one ordinary chemical addiction over one day. Does not cure luciferium dependency, genetic dependencies or drug tolerance. Repeated doses refresh the course without stacking its speed.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_MechaniteRegenT3_Item.de: A one-day course repairs fresh wounds, up to 2 injury points per hour. Does not heal scars, missing parts or implants.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_CombatStimT3_Item.label: Red line injector
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_CombatStimT3_Item.descri: For 8 hours: movement +25%, shooting accuracy factor +10%, pain -70%. Followed by 6 hours of fatigue. Repeated doses refresh, rather than stack, the effect.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_WorkStimT3_Item.label: Second shift concentrate
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_WorkStimT3_Item.descript: For one day: global work speed +35%, rest consumption halved. Followed by 6 hours of fatigue. Repeated doses refresh the same effect.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_ScarSerumT4_Item.label: Scar repair serum
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_ScarSerumT4_Item.descrip: Heals one permanent injury in natural tissue, then supports recovery for one day. Preserves implants and special psychic sacrifices.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_LimbSerumT4_Item.label: Limb regeneration serum
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_LimbSerumT4_Item.descrip: Restores one missing natural limb on an intact natural parent, then supports recovery for one day. Cannot restore the head or torso, replace implants, or reverse psychic sacrifices.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_GrechkaSerumT5_Item.desc: A one-day course repairs fresh injuries and one old scar or supported chronic condition in natural tissue. Preserves implants, genes, pregnancy and special psychic states. Does not resurrect or regrow missing parts; use the limb serum for that.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_YouthSerumT5_Item.label: Youth renewal serum
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_YouthSerumT5_Item.descri: Reduces human biological age by five years, down to a minimum of 25 years. Chronological age is unchanged. Has no effect on younger patients.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_ReactorT3_Building.label: pharmaceutical reactor T3
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_ReactorT3_Building.descr: Produces preparations up to tier 3. Requires a worker and power. Work speed x5.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_ReactorT4_Building.label: pharmaceutical reactor T4
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_ReactorT4_Building.descr: Produces preparations up to tier 4. Requires a worker and power. Work speed x12.
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_ReactorT5_Building.label: pharmaceutical reactor T5
LanguageData.GrechkaPharmacy_ReactorT5_Building.descr: Produces preparations up to tier 5. Requires a worker and power. Work speed x25.
